scope: source-only request-template overlap, not model evaluation or training
question: Does the existing exact-request FIT/DEV assignment contain request-only lexical-template overlap under two frozen, simple literal-redaction rules?

methods.exact: Existing NFKC, casefold, whitespace-fold query_group. Preserve original partition assignments.
methods.numbers: NFKC/casefold; replace standalone signed numbers with optional comma/dot/colon/slash/hyphen-separated digit groups by typed number marker; tokenize remaining Unicode words, dropping punctuation. Markers are typed token objects, never strings that can collide with user text.
methods.quotes_numbers: As numbers, first replace balanced ASCII double-quoted spans (backslash escapes allowed) and single-quoted spans bounded by nonword/start/end with typed string marker. No gold-argument dictionaries, tools, answers or catalog used.

analysis: Build independent full TRAIN request fingerprints before joining frozen lineage by exact record index/raw-line hash. Report accepted FIT/DEV counts, groups crossing partitions, DEV records with >=1 FIT partner, largest groups and complete hash-only row ledger. All methods reported; no threshold selection, embedding/model/tokenizer training, fuzzy nearest-neighbor search or split repairs. Full-TRAIN grouping ignores accepted membership; accepted subgroup membership was label/schema-dependent historically and is not relabeled label-blind.
predictions_and_limits: Exact normalized grouping must have zero accepted cross-split groups; fail if violated. Literal-template overlap is a warning with possible false positives/negatives, not semantic equivalence, factual label validity, measured contamination of a trained model or exhaustive paraphrase test. Even zero overlap never clears generalization or permits fitting.
falsifiers: Permuting/mutating answers/tools/metadata cannot change any request fingerprint or group
Quoted and numeric variants cluster but different intent words do not
Literal marker-looking words cannot impersonate typed markers
Wrong source/lineage pin, mismatched raw row hash, missing/duplicate record, malformed query fail closed
Original source/adapter/splits/labels/results unchanged; no Torch/tokenizer/xgrammar import

prior_art.reuse: Lee et al., Deduplicating Training Data Makes Language Models Better; deduplication as a data audit. These bespoke lexical heuristics are not that paper algorithm or a novel semantic method.

math: No neural graph/variant change. PNDS118 c8744f6990a29ab4a6daecabeb1073a7ab7366c0 conditional scalar Lean/Python scope unchanged; no new Lean claim. Full source IEEE/AD/provenance OPEN.
authorization: User two execution levels supersede blanket signer requirements for internal work. This source-only synthetic audit does not authorize real-world training, qualification, TEST, reward/safety certification or promotion.
preservation: All original corpus/checkpoints/history and H64 negatives immutable. No split change, new fit or promotion. User95k–105k/<=1%matched/equal originaldata/train+tune unchanged;500khistory separate. No remote inference fallback. All physical-device metrics NOT_RUN.
